title: KRYPTOS / PALIMPSEST / ABSCISSA legacy keys as substitution candidates
hypothesis_summary: K1, K2, K3 used PALIMPSEST, ABSCISSA, and Vigenere/columnar keys with KRYPTOS-mixed alphabets. The construction artist's keyword reuse is documented across the K1-K3 chain; K4 plausibly reuses a member of the same legacy keyword family in a substitution role. This pack enumerates the legacy keys as substitution candidates with KRYPTOS-mixed alphabet, not as a solve attempt.

provenance_items.quote_or_summary: K1=PALIMPSEST(Vigenere/KRYPTOS), K2=ABSCISSA(Vigenere/KRYPTOS), K3=KRYPTOS-related transposition. All published 1998-99.

composition_templates.rationale: K1-K3 legacy is Vig + columnar; K4 plausibly extends the family. This template enumerates Vig+col with legacy keys as substitution candidates.

constraints: PALIMPSEST and ABSCISSA are the public Vig keys for K1/K2 — they are Tier 2 derived facts about the construction, not Tier 1 facts about K4.
caveats: K4's two-system disclosure (Sanborn) means K1-K3 keys are NOT guaranteed to apply directly. This pack tests the keyword family hypothesis, not the specific keyword.
KRYPTOS-mixed alphabet support depends on existing AlphabetMode handling; the compiler currently uses default AZ for keyword pair families.
